name: application-live-match-timeline
title: Live Match Timeline
description: Live sports match event timeline: a horizontal minute axis with goal/card/substitution markers plotted proportionally at their minute, alternating above/below the line by team side.
useWhen: Showing a live or completed sports match's key events (goals, cards, substitutions) at a glance in a single compact bar.
You need events positioned proportionally along a fixed-length match clock rather than listed chronologically.
Distinct from a generic Timeline, which lists chronological entries vertically with full descriptions rather than plotting discrete events along a proportional minute-based axis.
avoidWhen: You need full event descriptions or commentary text — a vertical Timeline or match commentary feed is more appropriate.
The event count is high enough that markers would overlap at this scale — a scrollable list may read better.
responsiveBehavior: Event marker positions are computed as a percentage of match length, so the timeline reflows correctly at any container width without recalculating pixel offsets.
accessibility: Every event icon carries an aria-label naming the event type (Goal, Yellow card, Substitution), since meaning is otherwise conveyed by icon shape and color alone.
Each event also displays its minute as visible text, not just position along the axis, so the event's timing isn't lost without spatial context.

variants.title: Live Match Timeline
variants.description: Two goals, a yellow card, and a substitution plotted across a 90-minute axis with the home team's events above the line and the away team's below.
accessibility: Each event icon has an aria-label naming its type.

variants.title: Live Match Timeline (Dark)
variants.description: The same match timeline adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Event icon and axis contrast remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
